name: on-the-fly
description: Local-first Chrome extension for visually editing live websites

scripts.build:public: cross-env PUBLIC_AGENT_ENABLED=false PUBLIC_BACKEND_ENABLED=false LOCAL_DEV_AGENT_ENABLED=false OTF_DIAGNOSTICS=false node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.release:public: npm run build:public && npm run verify:public && npm run package:public
scripts.test:e2e:harness: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/harness.spec.ts
scripts.build:runtime-v2:diagnostics: cross-env OTF_RUNTIME_V2=true OTF_DIAGNOSTICS=true LOCAL_DEV_AGENT_ENABLED=true LOCAL_AGENT_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4317 node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:v2: npm run build:runtime-v2 && cross-env E2E_RUNTIME_V2=true playwright test
